description: This file defines a utility class 'Precision' in the package 'org.apache.commons.math3.util'. It provides methods for comparing floating-point numbers with specified error margins, handling special cases like NaN and signed zeros, and functions for rounding numbers to a specified precision. The class includes constants for machine epsilon and safe minimum in double precision, and defines methods for precise floating-point comparison based on ULPs (Units in the Last Place) as well as absolute and relative tolerances.

classes.name: Precision
classes.description: A utility class providing floating-point comparison and rounding methods, constants for machine epsilon and safe minimum, addressing issues like NaN, signed zero, and ULPs to facilitate precise numerical computations.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares two double values within an absolute error margin (eps) or number of ULPs, returning an integer indicating their relative ordering.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two float or double values are equal considering a small epsilon or number of ULPs, including special cases like NaN and signed zeros.

methods.name: equalsIncludingNaN
methods.description: Checks if two float or double values are NaN or approximately equal within a small error, including NaN comparisons.

methods.name: equalsWithRelativeTolerance
methods.description: Checks for approximate equality between two double values considering a relative tolerance.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Rounds a double or float to a specified number of decimal places using BigDecimal's rounding modes.

methods.name: roundUnscaled
methods.description: Rounds a scaled unscaled value based on specified rounding mode, used internally by round methods.

methods.name: representableDelta
methods.description: Computes an offset delta so that x + delta differs from x by a machine-representable floating number, useful in numerical derivatives.
